parsed.note_claim: Subsection (b)(5)(A) of 8 U.S.C. § 1254a states there is no judicial review of any determination of the Attorney General with respect to the designation, or termination or extension of a designation, of a foreign state under this subsection.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: There is no judicial review of any determination of the Attorney General with respect to the designation, or termination or extension of a designation, of a foreign state under this subsection.
parsed.reason: The cited page contains the exact statutory language quoted in the note under subsection (b)(5)(A).
